title: THIS APP IS A SCAM!! PROTECT YOUR MONEY, DON’T DOWNLOAD THE APP!
body:
Do yourself a favour and don’t download the app. 

I have come across this app on instagram and purchased the free trial week via their website. I have downloaded the app but cannot use the premium offer, it’s asking me to pay again. Also the payment of £23 was taken only 4 days after the subscription to the said 7days trial. 

When I realised that I couldn’t make use of the subscription I emailed them straight away to cancel the recurring payment. This is the only way to make the cancelation if you subscribed via website. I emailed on 2 different addresses three days ago but got no response. 

 As soon as the transaction is not pending anymore I will contact my bank to stop further payment from being taken from my account. 

Message to the developer: people work hard for their money. We want to pay for services that actually work. Shame on you for scamming people and taking advantage of them. Shame on you for ignoring emails and continuing to take payments for an app that cannot be used.

body:

I also just checked my subscription this morning and it is NOT telling me I have a lifetime membership but a WEEK membership? I want to cancel now so I don’t get charged, but then I guess I lose access to an app I’ve already paid for in a few days.

I would like a refund but seeing as the creator isn’t responding to these reviews, I don’t hold much hope.
